[SWS_SM_00616] CurrentState value during StateMachine State transition
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
When a
StateMachineNotification
interface is configured for the
StateMa-
chine
and a
StateMachine State
transition has been started, the value of the
CurrentState
field shall be set to "inTransition".
⌋
Please note that the value "inTransition" is set independently of the source (
Platform
Health Management
,
Execution Management
,
SMControlApplication
, ...)
and is kept, even if another
StateMachine State
transition, as reaction to an er-
ror notification, is performed.
